280739943.description:
Artist Unknown
Amethyst and Teal Agate Geode Set
Natural Crystal and Dyed Agate
Various sizes up to 5" height
Unsigned
This decorative three-piece gemstone set features a prominent amethyst crystal cluster and two polished agate geode halves. The amethyst specimen showcases a dense grouping of purple terminations emerging from a natural matrix base. The two agate pieces have been treated with a vibrant teal dye to highlight the natural concentric banding and quartz crystalline centers, which contrast sharply against the rough, earth-toned outer rinds. These pieces function excellently as shelf accents or organic decorative elements in a modernist or eclectic interior.
Amethyst cluster features natural prismatic crystal points with varying violet saturation
Agate slices exhibit polished faces revealing intricate geode interiors and quartz structures
Versatile sizes suitable for shelf display, desk accents, or as decorative bookends
Largest agate specimen measures approximately 5.5" in width based on visual scale
Condition:
Excellent natural condition. As geological specimens, these items feature inherent variations in color, texture, and crystal formation. The teal coloration in the agate is an enhancement; both agate pieces and the amethyst cluster are structurally sound with no significant damage beyond natural geological inclusions.
